scope: Binary laukika compound capacity over the current derived nominal-meaning inventory. Count meanings and grammatical relations, not distinct spellings or attested dictionary entries.

counted_relations.meaning_template: the second nominal meaning in a genitive relation to the first
counted_relations.counting_basis: The rule admits mutually related members in a genitive relation. A self-pair can express a distinct recursive or contrastive relation and is not removed merely because both member identities match.

counted_relations.meaning_template: an external referent characterized through the first and second nominal meanings
counted_relations.counting_basis: The compound denotes another referent. Member order is retained; identical member identities are withheld from this first capacity model.

counted_relations.meaning_template: the first and second nominal meanings taken together
counted_relations.counting_basis: Reversing the two semantic members does not create another coordination meaning in this count. Identical member identities are excluded.

counted_relations.meaning_template: the first and second nominal meanings taken as one collection
counted_relations.counting_basis: The collective reading is distinct from ordinary coordination. Reversal and identical-member duplication are excluded.

depth_two_boundary.description: Exactly one admitted depth-one compound meaning and one original nominal meaning become the two members of one further counted compound relation.
